newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs seen rangebound due holidays next week.
newsitem.headline: OLOs seen rangebound due holidays next week.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds are seen trading in tight ranges amid light volume next week, as the market closure in the U.K. on Monday and the closure in Belgium on Thursday and Friday will weigh on volumes.
Dealers expected that investors will consolidate positions and await further news on the U.S. economy, but see few domestic elements that could impact the OLO/Bund spread.
Trade came to a virtual standstill on Friday afternoon, as many traders had taken the day off following Thursday's Labour day holiday.
OLO futures, which had risen up to half a point following a lower-than-expected increase in April U.S. jobs came off highs in late trade to stand 29 bp higher.
The 10-year OLO yield stood at 5.88 percent, from 5.93 Thursday, the OLO/Bund spread remained at 10 bp.
Three month T-bill yields were quoted at 3.18/23 percent in early afternoon trade. The new August 7 bill will be auctioned on Monday, instead of Tuesday as ususal, because of the holiday season.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
